'''Saeid Abbasbandy''' is an Iranian mathematician<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://works.bepress.com/saeid_abbasbandy/ |title=Selected works |access-date=2012-08-30 |archive-date=2014-04-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140425084350/http://works.bepress.com/saeid_abbasbandy/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> and university [[professor]] at [[Imam Khomeini International University]]. Abbasbandy was born on March 17, 1967, in [[Tehran]]. He finished his high school course in Shariati High School and attended in the university entrance exam, then could enter [[University of Tehran]].

His paper "Homotopy analysis method for quadratic Riccati differential equation" was singled out by ''[[Science Watch]]'' as a "Hot Paper in Mathematics" in March 2009.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://sciencewatch.com/dr/nhp/2009/09marnhp/09marnhpAbba/ |title=Saeid Abbasbandy |publisher=ScienceWatch.com |date=2009-02-27 |accessdate=2012-09-04}}</ref>
Abbasbandy is editor-in-chief of a non-profit journal, ''[[Communications in Numerical Analysis]]''.

==Education==
He received a [[Master of Science]] degree in September 1991 and a [[PhD]] in February 1996 from [[Kharazmi University]]. The title of his thesis was ''Numerical Galerkin Methods for Integral Equations of the First kind''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://abbasbandy.com/education.htm |title=Education |publisher=Abbasbandy.com |date= |accessdate=2012-09-04}}</ref>
